integrity_note: The theorem and quantitative mass-design frontier are supported by an explicit analytic proof and independently reproducible exact-rational finite tests. Finite enumeration is not the proof. Prior-literature coverage is assessed to best knowledge, not a uniqueness guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Finite real cyclic signals of size at least three; exactly two nonempty averaging cells, strictly positive vertex masses, unweighted cyclic edge variation. The multi-cell, arbitrary-graph, and independently weighted-edge cases are not covered. A supremum over positive masses is not attained at its upper endpoint when there are at least two runs per color.
title: Sharp cyclic-variation stability of two-cell conditional expectations
